name: Australasian league (2026–27)
author: BallGM
description: Ten clubs, a soft cap of 2,167,359 with a floor of 1,950,643 and tax on any spend above the cap, best-of-three semi-finals and a best-of-five grand final; no draft, FIBA game rules. Figures in Australian dollars.

fidelity.detail: This league plays four 10-minute quarters; the match engine plays four 12-minute quarters, so per-game totals run about a fifth high. Rates (per possession, per 36 minutes, percentages) compare fairly.
Ten teams cannot share 33 games evenly between nine opponents; the preset plays 36 (four against each) so every schedule is balanced.
The top four go straight to the semi-finals; there is no play-in.
Up to four marquee players count against the cap at a fixed, discounted hit (267,560 for the first); here every salary counts in full.
Spending over the cap is taxed from the first dollar, but the preset states no tax rate, so the bill is reported without being charged.
No development contracts or the development-player minimum.
